verdict.rationale: Chroma documents a first-class LangChain integration page (with a link to a LangChain blog post) and an official Anthropic MCP server, showing maintained framework integrations exist, but the evidence pack lacks explicit mention of LlamaIndex or other agent frameworks, and no independent hands-on corroboration of integration quality is given. missing for 10: explicit LlamaIndex integration docs, broader multi-framework coverage (e.g., Haystack, Semantic Kernel), independent developer confirmation of integration reliability.
